# Facts

The project's facts: normative input documents, immutable and always true, that the project complies with (a protocol
specification, a device's technical specification, a user's guide). The user places them here; AGNOS never changes their
content. An AGNOS skill may transform a fact technically (a conversion to Markdown, for example) and index the facts with
unique IDs that the project's artifacts cite; until then, an artifact cites a fact by its path.
